Shell(cat > /Users/karan/github/hello/VisualBasic/AssetMaintenance/Services/AuthService.vb <<'VB' Imports System.Security.Cryptography Public Class AuthService Private Const Iterations As Integer = 100000 Private Const HashSize As Integer = 32 Private Const SaltSize As Integer = 16 Private ReadOnly _userRepo As IUserRepository Public Sub New(userRepo As IUserRepository) _userRepo = userRepo End Sub Public Sub CreateUser(username As String, password As String) If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username) Then Throw New ArgumentException("Username is required.") If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(password) OrElse password.Length < 6 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Password must be at least 6 characters.") End If If _userRepo.GetByUsername(username.Trim()) IsNot Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentException("Username already exists.") End If Dim salt = RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(SaltSize) Dim hash = Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2(password, salt, Iterations, HashAlgorithmName.SHA256, HashSize) Dim user = New User With { .Username = username.Trim(), .PasswordSalt = Convert.ToBase64String(salt), .PasswordHash = Convert.ToBase64String(hash) } _userRepo.Add(user) End Sub Public Function Authenticate(username As String, password As String) As User If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username) OrElse password Is Nothing Then Return Nothing Dim user = _userRepo.GetByUsername(username.Trim()) If user Is Nothing Then Return Nothing Dim salt = Convert.FromBase64String(user.PasswordSalt) Dim expected = Convert.FromBase64String(user.PasswordHash) Dim actual = Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2(password, salt, Iterations, HashAlgorithmName.SHA256, HashSize) If CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(actual, expected) Then Return user End If Return Nothing End Function End Class VB)
